note_ko: 장소 디테일 기준(docs/장소팩_작성기준.md)에 따라 작성. 한결 외출복 사진(1004)을 바탕으로 한 장소. {s}/{S}=she/She, {p}/{P}=her/Her, {o}=her, {lit}=빛이 닿는 의상 부분.
setting_en: a quiet tree-lined street in autumn
feature_en: tall ginkgo trees with golden-yellow leaves on both sides of the street
a low stone wall topped with a black iron fence
ground_en: a paved sidewalk covered in fallen yellow ginkgo leaves
gray paving stones scattered with small yellow leaves
far_en: the street running away between two rows of yellow trees
a few low buildings far down the street

오후.sky_en: a pale blue sky showing between the yellow leaves

해질녘.shadow_en: long soft shadows stretch across the pavement toward the camera's right
